text:
The candidate hypothesis introduces specific technical components and metrics—such as "multivariable integrated skill scores (MISS)", "Kolmogorov-Smirnov test", "mathematically determined weights based on historical model performance... cross-validated against observed data"—which are not mentioned or supported by the provided abstract. 

The study described in the evidence instead uses a multivariable integrated evaluation method to evaluate climatological mean and interannual variability, defines the similarity of multivariate error fields between pairwise models to measure model interdependency, and hierarchically clusters the top 15 models based on that similarity to identify relatively independent models.

Therefore, the candidate hypothesis contains specific unverified elements and does not align as the main hypothesis supported by the provided evidence.

VERDICT: REJECT
